scope: Single-query native PostgreSQL runtime/RLS plan investigation, not a complete-app or cloud throughput comparison.
change: Replace aggregate/sort over the complete active backlog with an ordered eligible partial-index prefix and lateral point partition lock. Up to128 enabled candidate events are considered; a first unlocked candidate permits early stop.
limitations: One EXPLAIN ANALYZE sample per scenario on independently initialized equal-cardinality fresh databases; timings include measurement noise and are not a workload speedup claim.
When every candidate in the128-event prefix belongs to locked partitions, a worker returns no claim and backs off; later queue entries await prefix progress.

Source-enabled filtering occurs before the logical window, but skipping paused-source or dead MVCC index entries can require additional physical reads; vacuum and queue health remain operational concerns.
